slot.brief: Group species by hybridisation from bond angle/geometry clues; pick the set where all members have the same hybridisation (e.g. include lone-pair species like NH3, H2O, SF4).

stem: Which set contains species whose central atoms all have the same hybridisation?

verdicts.working: NH₃ and H₂O are sp³; SF₄ is sp³d. BF₃, SO₃, and NO₃⁻ each have a trigonal-planar central atom and are sp². CH₄/NH₃ are sp³ while CO₂ is sp; PCl₅/SF₄ are sp³d while XeF₄ is sp³d².

working:
$\text{BF}_3$: trigonal planar, $sp^2$; $\text{SO}_3$: trigonal planar, $sp^2$; $\text{NO}_3^-$: trigonal planar, $sp^2$.
